picks.editorial_note: A Fermilab-led team was selected under DOE's new Genesis Mission to build AI systems that control particle accelerators, marking one of the first major national investments applying AI directly to fundamental physics infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A Google-led, government-backed North Atlantic trial will use AI to adjust flight paths and cut contrail-driven climate warming — a rare case of AI research moving straight into real-world aviation policy and practice.
picks.title: World’s first trial to test if flightpath changes could cut aviation’s climate impact

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute are combining AI with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate discovery of new battery materials, an industry-academia pairing with direct implications for energy storage technology.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs often can't be traced to any training example — is a significant scientific finding with major implications for copyright, AI transparency, and provenance debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's Rosen Center is a partner on over $42 million in NSF grants to build national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure, funding that will underpin research computing capacity across many institutions.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: NCSA and UCLA's $9 million NSF-funded iDLab will unify browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly advancing the federal NAIRR pilot's goal of democratizing AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: University at Buffalo's recognition for AI leadership highlights its access to Empire AI, New York's $500 million state-backed AI consortium — a signal of how large state investments are reshaping university AI capacity.
picks.title: UB School of Management recognized for AI leadership in global business education report

picks.editorial_note: A Kent State researcher's DOE Genesis Mission award to mine 50 years of water-quality data for critical minerals shows federal AI funding extending into resource security, a strategically important policy area.
picks.title: Kent State Researcher Selected for US Department of Energy Genesis Mission Award to Mine Decades of River Data for Critical Minerals; Kent State Today; July 29, 2026

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Laboratory's ARCADE agentic AI debriefing tool is being integrated into U.S. Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft operations, an early example of agentic AI entering active military decision-making workflows.
picks.title: Human–AI mission debrief enters the Air Force through ARCADE

picks.editorial_note: A University of Houston report projecting up to 32% growth in U.S. electricity demand by 2030, driven partly by AI data centers, underscores the infrastructure and policy planning challenges AI's growth is forcing onto national agendas.
picks.title: University of Houston Report Predicts U.S. Electricity Demand Could Rise 32% by 2030 | University of Houston
